text: What you'll do as a developer in the Microoft project. Welcome to Microoft, the open-source educational experiment where we're using AI to invest in AI. I'm excited to tell you about this unique volunteer opportunity that's eligible for OPT and will transform your understanding of agentic AI systems. As a developer in the Microsoft project, you'll join a collaborative community building an ecosystem of specialized AI agents that work together to analyze the rapidly evolving artificial intelligence sector. This isn't just another project. It's a hands-on laboratory where you'll discover what approaches actually work in practice. Here's what your journey will look like. You'll partner with another developer to focus on building one specific high

Impact tool within our framework. Think of it as creating your own specialized agent with a clear purpose. For example, you might develop a financial data agent that pulls critical metrics given a ticker symbol and generates comprehensive reports. Or perhaps you'll build a social media monitoring agent that tracks sentiment and emerging trends for specific companies. Some teams will focus on insider trading analysis tools that identify patterns and executive stock movements. Others might create agents that monitor congressional trades to spot potential market moving legislation. The possibilities are vast and you'll have the freedom to pursue what interests you most. For those interested in system architecture, you may work on

The Microoft layer itself that orchestrates an engine that coordinates these specialized tools as they're built. This is where the real magic happens as you'll develop systems that resolve conflicts between agents, prioritize actions, and maintain overall coherence. While there are hundreds of potential financial agents that could enhance our framework, your mission is focused. Take one tool from concept to production. Ready status. Once your agent is deployed, you can choose to refine it further or move on to building another component in our growing ecosystem. Throughout this process, you'll gain invaluable experience in designing and implementing agentic AI systems, creating tools that process complex financial information, building coordination mechanisms between

Autonomous agents, deploying production ready AI solutions with realworld applications. The Microoft project is more than just a technical challenge. It's an occasional journey where we build to learn. Join us in this collaborative experiment and help discover which approaches truly work in AI powered investment intelligence. Are you ready to use AI to invest in AI? Your journey with Microoft begins now.
